title: The blood-pressure widget reads its erase when the save is asked, not when the reading is typed
evidence: widget-src/src/widgets/FollowErase.tsx: each widget remounts its tree when a re-read moves the store's erase, and its saves take the tree's erase (useTreeErase). blood-pressure.ts Saves and transition: the claim at the first keystroke of a run, passed to savePair; useWidgetSave passes the tree's erase to saveMeasured. Tests: FollowErase.test.tsx, blood-pressure.transition.test.ts, BloodPressure.test.tsx US-75 AC8, standalone/widgets.test.tsx.
